item.title: Wrigley Field to host 1st Chicago HBCU Baseball Classic
item.description: CHICAGO — Wrigley Field is gearing up to host the first-ever Chicago HBCU Baseball Classic this spring. item.title: Flavor Flav invites USA women's hockey team to celebrate in Las Vegas
item.description: Rapper Flavor Flav has invited the USA women's Olympic hockey team to celebrate their big win in Las Vegas after the team turned down President Trump's invitation to his State of the Union address.

item.title: Indiana state lawmakers continue push for new Chicago Bears stadium in Hammond
item.description: With the current Indiana legislative session days from ending, Indiana lawmakers continue to fast-track a bill that would provide the financial framework for the Chicago Bears to move just over the state line and build a new stadium in Hammond.

item.title: Chicago overcharged $163 million in parking ticket fees, judge rules
item.description: A Cook County judge ruled that the City of Chicago overcharged residents for parking tickets by $163 million over 10 years, and refunds must be issued.

item.title: President Trump delivers first State of the Union since returning to White House
item.description: President Donald Trump will deliver his first State of the Union address since returning to the White House, as he faces economic challenges and a potential strike on Iran, with Democrats looking to capitalize on the situation.
